info.title: TRED Crew API
info.description: Sign in through /auth/login, then use Authorize with the accessToken. Swagger itself is restricted to active Admin accounts.

get.summary: Check API, PostgreSQL and Redis health

post.description: Creates a pending employee account. An Admin must approve it before login.
Use identifier for an email or username; the email field is supported for existing clients. Copy accessToken to Authorize.
Admin only. Invalidates all sessions immediately.
Admin only. Open the returned authorizationUrl in a browser and authorize the Lark user with access to the desired calendar. Then list and select the calendar.

get.description: Admin only. Lists calendars visible to the connected Lark user.

put.description: Admin only. Select a calendar returned by the list endpoint.

get.description: Admin only. Reports whether the calendar is configured, the automatic job state, and the last sync result.

post.description: Admin only. Imports Lark Calendar events into PostgreSQL. The first sync loads the full calendar; later calls use the saved incremental cursor. No request body is required.
Photo must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP data URL up to 3 MB. Event check-in requires an assignment.
